reviews.feedback: internal/jobs/jobs.go Enqueue (~line 113): `if len(r.queue) >= r.queueSize` makes NewRunner(n, 0, ...) reject every job, while the original unbuffered-channel code accepted a job whenever a worker was idle. Restore that by tracking idle workers under r.mu (increment before cond.Wait, decrement after it returns) and accepting when len(r.queue) < r.queueSize+idle. Add a test that a zero-queue runner with an idle worker accepts one job and returns ErrQueueFull for the next.
